Future<void> main() async {

  try {
    final config = await createProcessConfigFromJson(json: '{"language":"python"}');
    final result = await TreeSitterLanguagePackBridge.process('import os\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\ndef main():\n    pass\n', config: config);
